card.name: Cross-references to other sections
card.fires_on: The word or space ending a reference to another part of the text, such as "listed above", "previous chapters", "products below", or a section number inside "[see ...]". It also fires on a few nouns like "product" in standard warnings.

modes.label: Above/below pointers
modes.description: Words like above, below, or chapters that point to earlier or later text.

modes.label: Section number references
modes.description: Gap or closing bracket right after a section number in a "see" citation.

modes.label: Product in warning text
modes.description: The noun product in a stock child-safety warning.
modes.example: Keep this<< product>> out of reach of children.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated multilingual fragments.
